rationale_text: Case 11174_1001197: a 11.37 cc lesion in the peripheral zone is moderately hypointense on T2W (z=-1.17 relative to same-zone background tissue) with irregular, ill-defined (sphericity=0.55) margins. A substantial portion of the lesion falls outside the automated whole-gland segmentation, suggestive of extraprostatic extension (note: the gland mask is AI-derived and not verified at the capsule boundary, so this may partly reflect gland-segmentation imprecision rather than confirmed extension). These measurements are consistent with PI-RADS category 4.
